decisions.reason: Launched only in 2018 with its own page, its value is still uncertain and keeping it listed costs little, so the option is worth holding.
A second resin injection unit partly overlaps with A, but after one year there is no evidence it has failed, and carrying it costs little.
Spray guns are core accessories that fit the firm's established equipment range, so carrying costs are low and the option remains open.
A manual airless gun is a staple complementary product with steady demand and minimal carrying cost.
The air-assisted airless gun broadens the core offering at low cost, and its uncertainty has not yet resolved.
The data logger is a digital option with uncertain but potentially valuable upside and low listing cost, so management keeps it while demand becomes clear.
